WP_AC_1P_SWITCH.Description: Slayer weapons wielded by the elite Skyfighters.

WP_AC_BLACKCAT_00.Description: Some Slayers colloquially refer to them as "Murder Mittens."

WP_AC_COBALT.Description: A set of Slayer's aether strikers forged with archonite.

WP_AC_COBALT_SONY.Description: A Slayer's weapon frost-forged with concentrated archonite born in the intense pressures of the Maelstrom.

WP_AC_HP07A_MONK_00.Description: You look like you could use a little exorcise.

WP_AC_HP07A_MONK_01.Description: Like a slap in the face. Followed by another.

WP_AC_HP07B_WITCH_00.Description: They will do her bidding... and yours.

WP_AC_HP08A_HEROES_00.Description: Heed them and survive. Ignore them at your peril.

WP_AC_HP08B_PUNK_00.Description: Few are the Slayers who can tell them apart.

WP_AC_HP09A_ASSASSINS_01.Description: The union of these snakes is on the climb.

WP_AC_HP09B_COMMANDO_00.Description: Far more dangerous than an actual ram. Well, most actual rams. Benson might surprise you.

WP_AC_HP09B_COMMANDO_01.Description: Some call it an old-fashioned tune, but many are the Ostian Slayers who swear by "Fragtime."

WP_AC_HP10A_CELESTIAL_00.Description: An absence of matter does not mean an absence of force.

WP_AC_HP10A_CELESTIAL_01.Description: Catch some falling stars and mount them on your strikers. Save them for a painful fray.

WP_AC_HP10B_RAIDERS_00.Description: Absolutely not approved for use by members of the Ramsgate Pugilists' Club, which is probably for the best.

WP_AC_HP11A_ALCHEMIST_00.Description: They must always be considered before taking action. And then, if necessary, ignored.

WP_AC_HP12A_FROSTWARDEN_00.Description: "Make no truce nor treaty with foes."

WP_AC_FROSTFALL_MITTENS_00.Description: Keeping fingers both safe and warm against even the coldest of Behemoths.

WP_AC_IRON.Description: A set of Slayer's aether strikers forged with iron ore.

WP_AC_IRON_SONY.Description: Forged using a rare Ostian technique long thought lost.

WP_AC_IRON_XBOX.Description: Forged with rare ores found only in Ostia's Rugabuso Highlands.

WP_AC_ROMANTIC.Description: Worth far more than any empty gesture.

WP_AC_TRIALS_00.Description: A sterling set of aether strikers for those who have earned gilded marks on the Island of Trials.

WP_AC_TRIALS_01.Description: A golden set of aether strikers for those who have earned gilded marks on the Island of Trials and won the title "Trials Champion."
